criteria.name: background_modelled
criteria.description: Ignoring the background biases the half-life high by about 4.5 minutes on this data.
criteria.guidance: Read /app/report.md, the scripts the agent left in /app and its trajectory under trial/trajectory/. PASS when the fit includes a constant background term, or subtracts a background estimated from the data before fitting. FAIL when it fits a pure exponential to the raw counts, or when no method is shown.

criteria.name: uncertainty_from_data
criteria.description: The stated uncertainty should come from the data, not a guess.
criteria.guidance: Score 2 when the uncertainty comes from the fit's covariance, a chi-square or likelihood profile, or a resampling of the data, and the report names the method. Score 1 when it comes from the data but the report does not say how. Score 0 when it is guessed, fixed by hand or missing.

criteria.name: noise_model
criteria.description: Counts are Poisson; weighting by it is the standard choice.
criteria.guidance: Score 2 when the report names Poisson counting noise and the fit uses it, through weights or a Poisson likelihood. Score 1 when it names the noise but the fit does not use it. Score 0 when it says nothing about the noise.

criteria.name: reproducible
criteria.description: Someone else should get the same numbers from the workspace.
criteria.guidance: Score 2 when a script in /app produces the numbers in /app/answer.json and the report says how to run it. Score 1 when the method is described but no script is left, or the script does not match the answer. Score 0 otherwise.
